outer_batch_executing.meaning: an outer Covenant.multicall batch is being executed with _isMulticall set to true before delegating into MulticallLib.multicall

payload_invokes_nested_multicall.meaning: a payload item in the outer batch invokes Covenant.multicall again as a nested invocation

remaining_outer_items_present.meaning: the outer batch contains subsequent items following the nested invocation that are still part of the original multicall

payment_entrypoints_skip_enforcement.meaning: payment-sensitive entrypoints updateState, mint, redeem, swap rely on _checkPayment(msgValue) to skip msg.value == msgValue enforcement during batched execution

valid_sequence_completes.meaning: an otherwise valid delegated batch sequence that includes a nested multicall completes without being turned into a guaranteed revert for the remainder of the outer sequence

integration_griefed.meaning: an integration relying on delegated batching is griefed by inserting a nested multicall, turning an otherwise valid sequence into a guaranteed revert
integration_griefed.checkpoint: after nested multicall insertion in outer batch

assumptions: The nested multicall is inserted into an otherwise valid delegated batch sequence.
The griefing scenario is treated as a potential outcome, not an inevitable one.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify a concrete attacker actor or permission for inserting the nested multicall; griefing is described without an explicit unauthorized-caller statement.
Report does not state whether the nested invocation is intentional or accidental in the triggering scenario.

limitations: The selected impact is potential; the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional griefing scenario.
Exact number or identity of remaining outer batch items is not specified; represented as a Boolean presence fact.
Other impacts (outer_batch_items_revert, dos_persists_no_recovery) are not formalized by this plan.
